exact_resume_source: The 2026-11-14 repository snapshot explicitly set the next point to Ahvenanmaa / Föglö / Ruoka-apu. The older prompt reference to Brändö was stale; this run followed the repository state.

category_results.finding: The regional Matbanken service exists in the Åland audit, but no current Föglö-specific referral, collection place, collection time or eligibility route was found in the parish's current public information.
category_results.next_check: Ask Ålands södra skärgårdsförsamling/Matbanken to confirm whether Föglö residents can receive food bags and how/when.

category_results.finding: Ordinary home service and support services are fee-based or income-tested. The published Föglö elder-care tariff (effective 1.1.2022) charges 15 €/day for respite during statutory caregiver leave; the municipality's 21.2.2023 caregiver guidelines also say the recipient is charged according to the current fee tariff. A later regional legal amendment may affect this, but no 2026 local implementation/fee confirmation was found.
category_results.next_check: Obtain written confirmation of the 2026 fee and legal implementation from Föglö elder-care management before listing statutory respite as free.

category_results.finding: The existing regional Emmaus Åland voucher-based clothing aid record remains the only qualifying lead. No separate Föglö clothing bank or local distribution schedule was confirmed.
category_results.next_check: Confirm the local referral route through parish/social services; do not create a municipality-specific duplicate of Emmaus.

category_results.finding: The existing regional Emmaus Åland voucher-based goods aid record remains the only qualifying lead. No separate Föglö goods distribution was confirmed.
category_results.next_check: Confirm whether Föglö referrals can use the Emmaus voucher scheme and which goods are covered.

category_results.finding: Ålands södra skärgårdsförsamling's official support information identifies a Föglö diaconal fund intended to support people in financial difficulty. Application route, eligibility, grant/loan form, amount and regular contact time are not published.
category_results.next_check: Confirm the application route, non-repayable/repayable status, eligibility and current contact person with the parish.

category_results.finding: No separate free Föglö housing programme was confirmed. Existing regional KST means-tested income support remains the relevant record for necessary housing-related expenses; it must not be duplicated locally.
category_results.next_check: No local service to add until a distinct free housing programme is evidenced.
